description: This file is a test script written in shell that sets up various git repository states and performs tests related to detecting renames and type changes in files using 'git diff-tree'. It defines test cases for renames, cross-renames, and moves, verifying the correctness of git's diff detection mechanisms.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands within the test context.

methods.name: COPYING_test_data
methods.description: Test-specific function to copy data into files (assumed to exist in sourced scripts).

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and stages it for commit.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with staged changes.

methods.name: git tag
methods.description: Creates a tag pointing to the current commit.

methods.name: git rm
methods.description: Removes files from the working directory and stages the removal.

methods.name: cat
methods.description: Displays the contents of a file.
